title: HostCover Levels and Same-Day Claim Reimbursements in Payout Methods On-Request Payouts
content:
Hosts protected under Host Damage Protection (HostCover) have early access to claim reimbursements through Payout Methods on-request payouts. The on-request claim advance share, the part of the claim reimbursements credited to the method on the request date that an on-request payout includes, is set by the level of the host's active HostCover plan.

## Claim advance share by HostCover level

| Level of the host's active HostCover plan | On-request claim advance share |
|---|---|
| HostCover Premier | 100 percent |
| HostCover Elite | 100 percent |
| HostCover Estate | 100 percent |
| HostCover Standard | 50 percent |
| HostCover Plus | 50 percent |
| HostCover Essential | None |
| No active HostCover plan | None |

The level is read from the host's HostCover plan whose status is active; a plan that is pending activation, cancelled or lapsed is not an active plan.

## Hypothetical cases

- An imagined host with an active HostCover Plus plan has a USD 800.00 claim reimbursement credited to the method on the request date. The claim advance share for that reimbursement is 50 percent.
- An imagined host whose only HostCover plan, at HostCover Estate, was cancelled before the request date holds no active plan: the claim advance share is none.
- An imagined host with an active HostCover Elite plan: the claim advance share is 100 percent.

## Basis notes

- The share applies only to claim reimbursements credited to the method on the request date; reimbursements credited earlier are already part of the balance.
- The level is the HostCover level on the plan record, not the amount or the kind of the claim.
